topic.title: Git Actions in Other Views and Editors

body.p: In addition to the dedicated Git views and the top-level Git menu, the Git Client add-on contributes Git actions to contextual menus in other parts of . Use these actions when you want to run a Git operation on the selected resource or on the file open in the current editor.

section.title: Where Contextual Git Actions Are Available
section.p: The contextual actions are available for resources that belong to a Git repository in the following locations:

dlentry.dd: Right-click a file or folder from a Git repository and select the Git submenu. The actions apply to the selected resource.
Right-click a topic reference or map reference from a Git repository and select the Git submenu. The actions apply to the referenced resource.
Right-click in an editor opened in Text or Author mode and select the Git submenu. The actions apply to the current file.

section.title: Action Scope
section.p: The scope of a contextual Git action depends on where you open the menu. In the Project view, the action applies to the selected file or folder. In the DITA Maps Manager view, it applies to the referenced file. In an editor, it applies to the current file. If the selected resource is not part of a Git repository, Git actions are not available, or only repository setup actions are available.

section.title: Contextual Git Actions
section.p: Depending on the selected resource and context, the Git submenu can include the following actions:

dlentry.dd: Compares the selected resource with its repository version. This action is available in the Project view.
Starts a commit workflow for the selected resource. This action is available in the Project view.
Opens the Git History view for the selected resource or current file.
Shows blame information for the selected resource or current file.
Creates a Git repository in the selected folder. This action is available when the selected project folder is not already part of a local Git repository.
